finalText:
Migration finished — all 12 app files switched from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the already-migrated pattern exactly.

I deliberately left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` untouched: it's a vendored third-party file with a comment saying it's overwritten wholesale on every upgrade and local edits are silently lost, so patching it wouldn't stick. If you still want `db.query` gone everywhere, that one needs either an upstream fix/upgrade or a wrapper shim at the call site instead of an in-place edit — let me know if you want me to do the latter.
